verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API, listing operations such as client listing, session history and alias changes, and offers an open-source Python module with scripts. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable in-browser examples, and probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404. The Python scripts and CLI batch example are adjacent building blocks, not an interactive explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
